KSH.p: This is Kashinoga, my virtual home.
Here, you’ll find the (mostly) fun things that I’ve created or found.
I hope you enjoy your time here.

WRK.p: I’m a digital infrastructure engineer for U.S. energy companies.
I was formerly a software engineering consultant for the State of Iowa and other midwestern U.S. companies.
I have a B.S. in Computer Science from Iowa State University, and acquired general education from Drake University.

PRJ.p: Matrix, Nextcloud, and Open WebUI: for a better digital wellbeing.
Casual, community, and competitive gaming for friends.

APP.p: A collection of apps that I’ve built for personal use, shared with you.

ABT.p: I enjoy nature, literature, and video games — and heightened experiences.
I’m based in the Midwestern United States, with occasional visits to Southeast Asia for friends and family.
